newsitem.title: FRANCE: French finmin news conference 0830 GMT Monday.
newsitem.headline: French finmin news conference 0830 GMT Monday.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn will give a news conference at 0830 GMT on Monday, the finance ministry said on Friday.
The minister, accompanied by junior budget minister Christian Sautter, is due to present the results of an audit of public finances.
He is also expected to announce measures planned by the government to curb the budget deficit this year.
